## Batch 103 complete

I authored the eight A items and two B items, with frontmatter-only pages, updated manifests, proof contracts, source coverage, cross-batch evidence, notes, and Step 1 records. The [A page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/knot-theory/terminating-computations-for-classical-knot-invariants.md) and [B page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/knot-theory/terminating-computations-for-classical-knot-invariants-examples.md) are ready for review.

Eight items have hash-current `ready` records; two are `escalated`:

- [Exact bracket output bound](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/thm-exact-bracket-output-bit-growth-bound.md)
- [Bracket state-sum bound](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/thm-bracket-state-sum-exponential-bound.md)

The design’s crossing-only bound fails for general links: a crossingless \(m\)-component unlink has \(c=0\) and bracket degree \(2(m-1)\). I proved corrected bounds in \(c,m\), preserving the knot case, and escalated both items for owner scope reconciliation.

I also recorded a defect in batch 63’s `thm-quandle-colorings-are-reidemeister-invariant`: its final step 2.1 cites nonexistent step 2.3. The local Fox coloring lemma proves the needed odd-prime case; I did not edit the other batch’s item.

## Checks and remaining run blockers

Precheck passed; proof layout passed for all ten items with 32 steps and no defects; strict proof-contract validation passed for all seven proof-bearing items. Coverage passed for both pages with 17 harvested results, source fetch verified all six URLs, dependency levels match, and the TikZ diagram compiled with the application renderer. Sources read include [Calegari’s notes](https://math.uchicago.edu/~dannyc/notes/knot_theory.pdf), [Roberts’s course notes](https://webhomes.maths.ed.ac.uk/~v1ranick/papers/knotes.pdf), and [Kauffman’s paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2204.12104v2).

Batch evidence is in the [notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-103.notes.md), [manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-103.pages.json), [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-103.proof-contracts.json), [coverage](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-103.coverage.json), and [cross-batch dependencies](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-103.cross-batch-dependencies.json).

The live run remains on owner hold at 32/109. Its blocker concerns batches 31 and 56, outside batch 103’s direct prerequisites. The run-wide dependency and Step 1 checks also remain open on work outside this batch.
